invariants.rationale: Rectangle bounds heights are generally non-negative by convention and in most geometric representations.
Rectangle.getHeight() should return a finite float value, as infinite or NaN values are unlikely for a bounds height.
The method directly returns rectangle.getHeight(), so the result should always equal this call.
As a float value from a rectangle, the height should not exceed the maximum float value.
Rectangle heights should not be NaN, as a shape should have a determinable height.
